Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates an agent’s ability to fix real bugs in open-source Python repositories by generating patches that make hidden unit tests pass. The “Verified” subset consists of issues confirmed by human annotators to be solvable with the provided repository context and test harness, reducing noise from ambiguous tasks.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Adaptive Error Correction (minor)
L3: Self-reflection (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends the SWE-bench paradigm beyond Python, evaluating bug-fixing and patch generation across multiple programming languages and ecosystems. It stresses whether an agent can transfer software-engineering skills across different syntaxes, tooling conventions, and library idioms.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger, harder software-engineering benchmark designed to be more realistic and contamination-resistant, with tasks spanning multiple languages and more complex repositories. It evaluates whether agents can produce correct, high-quality patches under more challenging constraints and broader industrial context.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Planning, Decision-making, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Adaptive Error Correction (minor)
L3: Self-reflection (minor)

Success requires choosing and sequencing shell commands, interpreting tool output, and iteratively correcting failures under resource constraints.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Planning, Decision-making, Working Memory, Logical Reasoning, Adaptive Error Correction
L3: Inhibitory Control (minor)

Cognitive Functions:

Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Scene Understanding & Visual Reasoning, Spatial Representation & Mapping (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: Vending-Bench 2 evaluates long-horizon agent coherence by simulating management of a vending-machine business over an extended time period, requiring many interdependent decisions. Cognitive Functions:
L1:

Description: FinanceAgent measures how well models perform tasks typical of an entry-level financial analyst, such as analyzing financial statements, extracting figures, performing calculations, and producing justified recommendations.
